# Competitive Signal Report — Enterprise AI Platform (Tuesday, 25 August 2026)

> **Bottom line:** Competitors are increasingly focusing on agentic AI capabilities, but gaps in true omnichannel, predictable pricing, and independent analyst validation persist, creating clear openings for Kore.ai's established platform leadership.

### ServiceNow Unifies Agentic AI Under "Otto"

**What happened —** (2026-08-25) ServiceNow announced the unification of its agentic AI offerings under the "Otto" umbrella, integrating Moveworks and consolidating offerings into Foundation, Advanced, and Prime tiers. [CX Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPdW5VT3JTd2NZQWZJckpwUUo3MV8tR2dOMjFxUFpLTUlvS1hMT2ZSS0EtZVB0emxRbUNiZVRkbktpa2l2RGVIbFczX0UzcXhsbjhPcG9VOVlCUXRnUUFRVDZEUDVKOHBVSXNDZFpGQUNJb092TVZRd2lBX2R0R3g4aGJLTVZNR0RBQmZqYVdQQU5fc0hRTzVHenA5UFdJanl1UzhTc3NTZDZOSXlON1pxcFVJNHktenpzaTVQSEE1S2l3R0tnTEU0?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** This move highlights ServiceNow's ITSM-centric approach to agentic AI, reinforcing Kore.ai's position as a purpose-built, omnichannel CX platform with broader applicability and a more transparent pricing model.

### Salesforce Agentforce Pushes Audited Resolution Over Chatbot Containment

**What happened —** (2026-08-24) Dreamforce 2026 discussions emphasized moving CX teams beyond chatbot containment towards audited AI resolution, signaling a shift in Salesforce's agentic AI strategy. [MarketScale](https://news.google.?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** This validates Kore.ai's long-standing focus on audited, deterministic resolution, differentiating us from platforms still emphasizing basic containment and offering a clear advantage in regulated industries.

### PolyAI Deepens Healthcare Integration with Epic

**What happened —** (2026-08-24) PolyAI announced a direct integration with Epic, with PDS Health being one of the first to deploy it, targeting voice automation within healthcare systems. [DrBicuspid.com](https://news.google.?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** While PolyAI focuses on specific vertical integrations, Kore.ai's platform-agnostic approach and broader omnichannel capabilities provide a more comprehensive and adaptable solution for diverse enterprise needs, including healthcare, without being tied to a single EHR vendor.

| Competitor | Move (dated) | Threat | Kore.ai counter |

| PolyAI | (2024-08-24) Launches direct Epic integration for healthcare voice automation | Med | Platform-agnostic, true omnichannel vs. vertical-specific |

## Watch for
- Continued emphasis from Salesforce on "audited resolution" and its implications for their pricing and platform architecture.
- Further details on ServiceNow's "Otto" strategy and how it addresses non-ITSM use cases.
- PolyAI's expansion beyond voice and into broader digital channels.

## Recommended actions
- Emphasize Kore.ai's proven leadership in audited, deterministic AI resolution in all customer conversations and marketing materials.
- Highlight our platform's true omnichannel capabilities, contrasting with ITSM-centric or voice-first approaches.
- Reinforce our provider-agnostic stance and flexible model routing as a key differentiator against vendor lock-in.
- Continue to leverage analyst validation (Gartner, Forrester) as a primary proof point for platform superiority in CX-specific conversational AI.
